content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains disturbing themes related to psychological horror, such as fear, abandonment, and family trauma.
There are no explicit sexual scenes or extreme violence, but the atmosphere, sound design, and narrative may be unsettling for some players.
The game includes depictions of darkness, claustrophobic environments, paranormal activity, and stressful situations.

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: macOS 10.13 or later
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Quad-Core or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro 450 or R9 M290X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 or later
  • Processor: Apple M4
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated M1 GPU or Radeon Pro 570X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible sound card
